technical_and_design_decisions: Use Spring Boot auto-configuration to implement the Boot-based ModuleRunner for container-managed environments.
Design the new metrics REST API endpoints to return JSON payloads aggregating all requested metric types (counters, gauges, rich-gauges).
Refactor test infrastructure using Spring Profiles to cleanly separate mock and real repository implementations.
Adapt the existing gpfdist sink code into a reusable batch writer component for the jdbcgpfdist batch job.
Migrate the Reactor data processor module into the core repository, ensuring it aligns with the core module's build and packaging standards.
assumptions: The developer is familiar with the existing codebase, Spring XD architecture, and related technologies (Sqoop, GemFire, Greenplum).
Documentation will be authored in Markdown or AsciiDoc and integrated into the existing documentation pipeline.
Existing unit and integration tests are present and will be updated to reflect the changes.
The 'GF' source refers to GemFire, and 'HAWQ/GPDB' refers to Greenplum Database.
No new infrastructure setup is required; existing CI/CD pipelines will be used.

activities.activity_description: Analyze all user stories, define the technical approach, and design the necessary architectural changes across the increment.
Implement and configure the option to change the default Sqoop metastore to a user-defined database.
Write and publish documentation detailing how to configure the HDFS backed module registry.
Develop REST API endpoints to fetch all counters, gauges, and rich-gauges in a single request.
Implement a Boot-based ModuleRunner to allow running XD in container-managed environments without xd-containers.
Enable native GemFire authentication for the GF source and document the required security properties.
Create an out-of-the-box jdbcgpfdist batch job by reusing existing gpfdist sink code and adapting it to the batch model.
Separate mocks from real repository coupling in the test infrastructure to allow testing against a thin layer of dependencies.
Move the project reactor based data processor module from the spring-xd-module repo to the core repository.
Perform unit, integration, and regression testing across all implemented features and refactored components.
Prepare build scripts, release notes, and deployment artifacts for the software increment.
